name: Plain Teen Patti
twist: Seedha, classic khel. Koi twist nahi.
twistEn: Straight, classic game. No twist.

setupSteps.hi: Poori 52 patton ki gaddi pheento.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle the full 52-card deck.

setupSteps.hi: Har kursi ko 3 patte baantein, ulte.
setupSteps.en: Deal 3 cards face down to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Sab ko bata dein: koi joker nahi, seedha khel.
setupSteps.en: Tell everyone: no jokers, plain game.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Classic Teen Patti. Sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
summary.en: Classic Teen Patti. Best hand wins.

name: Muflis
twist: Sabse kam hand jeetta hai
twistEn: The lowest hand wins

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Ranking ulti hai: Trail sabse kharaab hand, High card sabse achha.
setupSteps.en: Ranking is reversed: Trail is the worst hand, high card the best.

setupSteps.hi: Ek jaise hand mein chhote patte jeette hain (K-high J-high se haarta hai).
setupSteps.en: Between hands of the same type, lower cards win (K-high loses to J-high).

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse kam hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the lowest hand wins.

readAloud.hi: Muflis hai. Sabse kam hand jeetta hai.
readAloud.en: It is Muflis. The lowest hand wins.

summary.hi: Ranking ulti. Sabse kam hand jeetta hai.
summary.en: Ranking reversed. The lowest hand wins.

note.hi: K♥ K♦ 9♣ (pair) se kam hai, isliye jeetta.
note.en: It is lower than K♥ K♦ 9♣ (a pair), so it wins.

note.hi: A♥ A♣ A♦ se jeetta: chhote patte jeette.
note.en: Beats A♥ A♣ A♦: lower cards win.

name: Pot Blind
twist: Koi patta nahi dekhta, chaal double
twistEn: Nobody looks, the chaal doubles

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Koi apne patte nahi dekhega. Sab blind.
setupSteps.en: Nobody looks at their cards. Everyone plays blind.

setupSteps.hi: Side show nahi hota. Chaal har round double hoti hai.
setupSteps.en: No side show. The chaal doubles every round.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

readAloud.hi: Koi patta nahi dekhega. Chaal har round double.
readAloud.en: Nobody looks. The chaal doubles every round.

summary.hi: Sab blind. Side show nahi. Chaal double.
summary.en: All blind. No side show. Chaal doubles.

name: Matha
twist: Maathe par ek patta, sabse bada jeetta
twistEn: One card on the forehead, highest wins

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 1 patta baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 1 card to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Sab apna patta maathe par rakhein, saamne ki taraf, bina dekhe. Baaki sab dekh sakte hain.
setupSteps.en: Everyone holds their card on the forehead, facing out, without looking. Everyone else can see it.

setupSteps.hi: Koi pack nahi kar sakta.
setupSteps.en: Nobody can pack.

setupSteps.hi: Sabse bada patta jeetta hai (ikka sabse bada).
setupSteps.en: The highest card wins (ace is high).

summary.hi: Ek patta maathe par. Sabse bada jeetta hai.
summary.en: One card on the forehead. Highest wins.

twist: Teen patte, 21 ke sabse kareeb jeeto
twistEn: Three cards, closest to 21 wins

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Teeno patton ka jod karein. Tasveer wale patte 10, ikka 1 ya 11, baaki jitna likha.
setupSteps.en: Add the three cards. Face cards are 10, ace is 1 or 11, others face value.

setupSteps.hi: 21 se upar gaye to bust, aap out.
setupSteps.en: Over 21 is bust, you are out.

setupSteps.hi: Show par 21 ke sabse kareeb wala jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the hand closest to 21 wins.

summary.hi: Jod karo. 21 ke sabse kareeb jeetta hai.
summary.en: Add them up. Closest to 21 wins.

note.hi: 10 + 5 + 6 = 21. Isse kareeb koi nahi.
note.en: 10 + 5 + 6 = 21. Nobody can be closer.

twist: Teen patte jodkar 999 ke kareeb jao
twistEn: Make the number closest to 999

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Keemat: K, Q, J, 10 = 0. Ikka = 1. 2 se 9 jitna likha.
setupSteps.en: Values: K, Q, J, 10 = 0. Ace = 1. 2 to 9 face value.

setupSteps.hi: Apne teen patte jodkar teen ank ka sabse achha number banayein. Suit ka matlab nahi.
setupSteps.en: Arrange your three cards into the best three-digit number. Suits do not matter.

setupSteps.hi: Show par 999 ke sabse kareeb number jeetta hai. 9-9-9 sabse achha.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the number closest to 999 wins. 9-9-9 is best.

summary.hi: 999 ke sabse kareeb number jeetta hai.
summary.en: The number closest to 999 wins.

note.hi: A♠ A♥ A♦ (111) aur 8♠ 8♥ 8♦ (888) isse haarte hain.
note.en: A♠ A♥ A♦ (111) and 8♠ 8♥ 8♦ (888) both lose to it.

name: Faceoff
twist: Sirf 20 patte: 10, J, Q, K, A
twistEn: A 20-card deck: 10, J, Q, K, A

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi se 2 se 9 tak ke saare patte alag kar dein. Sirf 10, J, Q, K, A (20 patte) rakhein.
setupSteps.en: Remove every 2 to 9. Keep only 10, J, Q, K, A (20 cards).

setupSteps.hi: Chhoti gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein. Zyada se zyada 6 log.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle the small deck and deal 3 cards to every seat. At most 6 players.

setupSteps.hi: Ranking plain jaisi hai. Isliye teen gulaam (J-J-J), A-A-K ko haraa dete hain.
setupSteps.en: Ranking is standard, so a trio of jacks beats A-A-K.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: 20 patton ki gaddi. Ranking plain jaisi.
summary.en: A 20-card deck. Standard ranking.

note.hi: A♥ A♣ K♥ (pair) ko haraata hai.
note.en: Beats A♥ A♣ K♥ (a pair).

note.hi: Q♦ J♥ 10♦ se bada sequence hai.
note.en: A higher sequence than Q♦ J♥ 10♦.

name: Potluck
twist: Sirf ek round, blind ya seen
twistEn: One round only, blind or seen

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Sirf ek round hota hai. Har koi pack, blind ya seen khelta hai.
setupSteps.en: Only one round. Each player packs, plays blind or plays seen.

setupSteps.hi: Har koi ek hi chaal chalta hai, apne patte ki sthiti ke hisaab se.
setupSteps.en: Each player makes one chaal, matching the status of their cards.

setupSteps.hi: Jo bache wo show karein. Sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: Everyone left shows. The best hand wins.

summary.hi: Ek round. Pack, blind ya seen. Phir show.
summary.en: One round. Pack, blind or seen. Then show.

name: Red & Black
twist: Laal patta: plain. Kaala patta: muflis
twistEn: Red card: plain. Black card: muflis

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bachi gaddi se ek patta palten.
setupSteps.en: Turn one card from the rest of the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Laal nikla to Plain khelein. Kaala nikla to Muflis khelein.
setupSteps.en: Red means play Plain. Black means play Muflis.

setupSteps.hi: Plain mein sabse bada, Muflis mein sabse kam hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: In Plain the best hand wins, in Muflis the lowest.

summary.hi: Laal: plain. Kaala: muflis. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Red: plain. Black: muflis. Rules to be checked.

name: 2 Cards Open
twist: Do patte khule, ek band
twistEn: Two cards face up, one face down

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento. Har kursi ko 3 patte baantein: 2 seedhe (khule), 1 ulta.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle. Deal 3 cards each: 2 face up, 1 face down.

setupSteps.hi: Sab doosron ke khule patte dekh sakte hain.
setupSteps.en: Everyone can see the others' open cards.

setupSteps.hi: Blind ya seen nahi hota.
setupSteps.en: No blind or seen play.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Do patte khule. Blind ya seen nahi.
summary.en: Two cards open. No blind or seen.

name: High-Low Split
twist: Sabse bada aur sabse chhota hand, dono jeette
twistEn: Best and worst hands both win

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Pehle tay karein kitne round (6 se 10). Pehle teen round koi pack nahi karta. Side show nahi hota.
setupSteps.en: Agree the number of rounds first (6 to 10). Nobody packs in the first three rounds. No side show.

setupSteps.hi: Round poore hone par sab show karte hain. Bina bole sabse bada aur sabse chhota hand dekha jata hai ("cards speak").
setupSteps.en: After the last round everyone shows. The best and worst hands are found without declaring ("cards speak").

setupSteps.hi: Sabse bade aur sabse chhote hand, dono jeette hain.
setupSteps.en: The best hand and the worst hand both win.

summary.hi: Bada aur chhota hand dono jeette. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Best and worst hands both win. Rules to be checked.

name: Best of Four
twist: Chaar patte, sabse achhe teen rakho
twistEn: Four cards, keep your best three

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 4 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 4 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Sabse achhe teen rakhein, ek patta ulta phenk dein.
setupSteps.en: Keep your best three and discard one face down.

setupSteps.hi: Sab apne patte dekhte hain, isliye blind khel nahi hota.
setupSteps.en: Everyone sees their cards, so no blind play.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Chaar mein se achhe teen rakho.
summary.en: Keep the best three of four.

note.hi: 2♣ phenk diya. K-K-9 ki jodi bachi.
note.en: Discard the 2♣. K-K-9 is a pair.

name: One-Eyed Jack
twist: Sirf J♥ aur J♠ joker
twistEn: Only J♥ and J♠ are jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento. Koi patta nikalna nahi hai.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle. Nothing is removed from the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Sirf Hukam ka gulaam J♠ aur Paan ka gulaam J♥ joker hain. J♦ aur J♣ normal patte hain.
setupSteps.en: Only the J♠ and J♥ are jokers. The J♦ and J♣ are normal cards.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Sirf do gulaam joker: J♥ aur J♠.
summary.en: Only two jacks are jokers: J♥ and J♠.

note.hi: Joker 6 ban gaya, sequence bani.
note.en: The joker becomes 6, making a sequence.

name: Joker
twist: Ek patta nikalo, uski rank joker
twistEn: Pull a card, its rank is the joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bachi gaddi se ek patta bina dekhe nikalein aur saamne rakhein.
setupSteps.en: Pull one card at random from the rest of the deck and show it.

setupSteps.hi: Us rank ke chaaron patte joker hain. Joker kisi bhi patte ki jagah chalta hai.
setupSteps.en: All four cards of that rank are jokers and stand in for any card.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Nikle patte ki rank joker hai.
summary.en: The pulled card's rank is the joker.

note.hi: Nikla 8♣. 8 joker hai, hearts mein Q ban gaya.
note.en: Pulled 8♣. The 8 is a joker and becomes Q of hearts.

name: Suit Joker
twist: Ek patta nikalo, uska poora suit joker
twistEn: Pull a card, its whole suit is joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bachi gaddi se ek patta nikalein aur saamne rakhein.
setupSteps.en: Pull one card from the rest of the deck and show it.

setupSteps.hi: Us suit ke saare 13 patte joker hain.
setupSteps.en: All 13 cards of that suit are jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Nikle patte ka poora suit joker.
summary.en: The pulled card's whole suit is joker.

note.hi: Nikla ♣. 8♣ joker hai, to teeno ikke.
note.en: Pulled ♣. The 8♣ is a joker, so three aces.

name: AK47
twist: A, K, 4 aur 7 joker hain
twistEn: A, K, 4 and 7 are jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento. Koi patta nikalna nahi hai.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle. Nothing is removed from the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bata dein: ikka, badshah, 4 aur 7 joker hain. Har suit ke, kul 16 patte.
setupSteps.en: Announce: aces, kings, 4s and 7s are jokers. Every suit, 16 cards in all.

setupSteps.hi: Plain jaisa khelein. Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: Play as Plain. At the show, the best hand wins.

readAloud.hi: A, K, 4 aur 7 joker hain, har suit ke.
readAloud.en: A, K, 4 and 7 are jokers, of every suit.

summary.hi: Plain jaisa, bas jokers alag.
summary.en: Just like Plain, only the jokers differ.

note.hi: Teeno joker hain, to sabse bada trail.
note.en: All three are jokers, so the best trail.

note.hi: A♠ 2♠ 2♥ (2-2-2) ko haraata hai.

twist: A, 9, 4, 7 joker hain
twistEn: A, 9, 4 and 7 are jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento. Koi patta nikalna nahi hai.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle. Nothing is removed from the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Ikka, 9, 4 aur 7 har suit ke joker hain. Kul 16 patte.
setupSteps.en: Ace, 9, 4 and 7 of every suit are jokers. 16 cards in all.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: A, 9, 4, 7 joker.
summary.en: A, 9, 4, 7 are jokers.

note.hi: 7 aur 4 joker hain, to teeno K.
note.en: The 7 and 4 are jokers, so three kings.

name: Ek Duje Ke Liye
twist: A, K aur 2 joker hain
twistEn: A, K and 2 are jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento. Koi patta nikalna nahi hai.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle. Nothing is removed from the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Ikka, badshah aur 2 har suit ke joker hain. Kul 12 patte.
setupSteps.en: Ace, king and 2 of every suit are jokers. 12 cards in all.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: A, K, 2 joker.
summary.en: A, K, 2 are jokers.

note.hi: Teeno joker hain, to sabse bada trail.
note.en: All three are jokers, so the best trail.

name: 1942 A Love Story
twist: A, 9, 4, 2 joker; English mana hai
twistEn: A, 9, 4, 2 are jokers; no English

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento. Koi patta nikalna nahi hai.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle. Nothing is removed from the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Dealing se pehle bata dein: sirf Hindi bolna hai. English bola to out.
setupSteps.en: Before dealing, announce: Hindi only. Speak English and you are out.

setupSteps.hi: Har kursi ko 3 patte baantein. Ikka (1), 9, 4 aur 2 har suit ke joker hain.
setupSteps.en: Deal 3 cards to every seat. Ace (as 1), 9, 4 and 2 of every suit are jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

readAloud.hi: A, 9, 4 aur 2 joker hain. English bola, to out.
readAloud.en: A, 9, 4 and 2 are jokers. Speak English, you are out.

houseRule.hi: Ghar ka niyam: saare Hearts bhi joker
houseRule.en: House rule: all Hearts are jokers too

summary.hi: A, 9, 4, 2 joker. English bola to out.
summary.en: A, 9, 4, 2 are jokers. Speak English, you are out.

note.hi: 9 joker hai, J ban gaya.
note.en: The 9 is a joker and becomes J.

name: Lowest Joker
twist: Sabse chhota patta joker
twistEn: Your lowest card is the joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Apna sabse chhota patta aapka joker hai.
setupSteps.en: Your lowest card is your joker.

setupSteps.hi: Sabse chhoti rank ki jodi ho, to dono joker.
setupSteps.en: If your lowest rank is a pair, both are jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Apna sabse chhota patta joker.
summary.en: Your lowest card is the joker.

note.hi: K ki jodi sabse chhoti hai, dono joker.
note.en: The K pair is lowest, so both are jokers.

note.hi: 2 joker hai, Q♠ ban gaya: spades ka sequence.
note.en: The 2 is a joker, becoming Q♠: a spade sequence.

name: Highest Joker
twist: Sabse bada patta joker
twistEn: Your highest card is the joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Apna sabse bada patta aapka joker hai.
setupSteps.en: Your highest card is your joker.

setupSteps.hi: Sabse badi rank ke kai patte hon, to sab joker.
setupSteps.en: If several cards share the highest rank, all are jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Apna sabse bada patta joker.
summary.en: Your highest card is the joker.

name: Marriage Jokers
twist: Nikle patte ke aas-paas ki rank joker
twistEn: The pulled rank and its neighbours are jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bachi gaddi se ek patta nikalein.
setupSteps.en: Pull one card from the rest of the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Uski rank, aur uske upar-neeche ki rank, har suit mein joker hain. Kul 12 patte. Ikke ke padosi K aur 2 hain.
setupSteps.en: That rank plus the rank above and below are jokers in every suit: 12 cards. The ace's neighbours are K and 2.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Nikli rank aur uske padosi joker. Aflatoon bhi kehte hain.
summary.en: The pulled rank and its neighbours are jokers. Also called Aflatoon.

note.hi: Nikla 5♥: 4, 5, 6 joker. 4 aur 5 joker hain, to teeno 8.
note.en: Pulled 5♥, so 4, 5, 6 are jokers. The 4 and 5 are jokers, so three 8s.

name: Odd Even Joker
twist: Nikla patta tay kare: odd ya even joker
twistEn: The pulled card sets odd or even jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bachi gaddi se ek patta nikalein.
setupSteps.en: Pull one card from the rest of the deck.

setupSteps.hi: Odd rank (A, 3, 5, 7, 9, J, K) nikli to saare odd patte joker. Even rank (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, Q) nikli to saare even patte joker.
setupSteps.en: An odd rank (A, 3, 5, 7, 9, J, K) makes every odd card a joker. An even rank (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, Q) makes every even card a joker.

setupSteps.hi: Do hand barabar hon, to jo pehle show karta hai wo haarta hai. Warna sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: If two hands tie, whoever shows first loses. Otherwise the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Odd ya even patte joker. Barabar par pehle show karne wala haarta hai.
summary.en: Odd or even cards are jokers. On a tie, the first to show loses.

name: Lallan Kallan
twist: Alag rang ka patta joker
twistEn: The odd-coloured card is the joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Apne teen patton mein jo ek alag rang ka hai, wahi aapka joker.
setupSteps.en: In your three cards, the one odd-coloured card is your joker.

setupSteps.hi: Do laal aur ek kaala: kaala joker. Do kaale aur ek laal: laal joker.
setupSteps.en: Two red and one black: the black is the joker. Two black and one red: the red is.

setupSteps.hi: Teeno ek hi rang ke hon to aap out. Baaki mein sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: All three the same colour and you are out. Among the rest, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Alag rang ka patta joker. Ek rang ke teen: out.
summary.en: The odd colour is the joker. Three alike: out.

note.hi: Kaala 3 alag rang ka hai, wahi joker.
note.en: The black 3 is the odd colour, so it is the joker.

name: Hi-Lo
twist: Sabse bada aur chhota patta joker
twistEn: Highest and lowest cards are jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Aapka sabse bada aur sabse chhota patta, dono joker hain.
setupSteps.en: Your highest and your lowest cards are both jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Jodi ke patte bhi joker hain.
setupSteps.en: Cards in a pair are jokers too.

setupSteps.hi: Do hand barabar hon, to jo pehle show karta hai wo haarta hai. Warna sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: If two hands tie, whoever shows first loses. Otherwise the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Bada, chhota aur jodi: sab joker.
summary.en: High, low and pairs are all jokers.

note.hi: A aur 2 joker hain, bacha K, to teeno K.
note.en: The A and 2 are jokers, leaving K, so three kings.

name: Revolving Joker
twist: Khule teen patte badalte rehte hain
twistEn: Three open cards that keep changing

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Dealer teen patte seedhe karke rakhe. Un teeno ranks ke saare patte joker hain.
setupSteps.en: The dealer turns three cards face up. Every card of those three ranks is a joker.

setupSteps.hi: Jab bhi koi pack kare ya side show haare, dealer teeno khule patte naye teen se badal de. Ye tab tak, jab tak do log bachein ya show na ho.
setupSteps.en: Each time a player packs or loses a side show, the dealer replaces the three open cards with three new ones. This goes on until two players are left or a show is forced.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Teen khule patte joker, aur badalte rehte hain.
summary.en: Three open cards are jokers, and they keep changing.

name: Kissing Missing
twist: Paanch patte, jodi se joker
twistEn: Five cards, pairs make jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 5 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 5 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Do patton se ek joker bana sakte hain: jodi ("kiss") ya ek ank ke fark wale patte jaise 6 aur 8 ("miss"). Wo do patte ek joker ginte hain.
setupSteps.en: You may form one joker from two cards: a pair ("kiss") or two cards one rank apart like 6 and 8 ("miss"). Those two cards count as one joker.

setupSteps.hi: Ek aur patta phenkein aur do normal patte plus joker khelein. Joker na bane to do patte phenk kar teen khelein.
setupSteps.en: Discard one more card and play two normal cards plus the joker. If no joker is possible, discard two cards and play three.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Jodi ya paas ke patte milakar ek joker.
summary.en: A pair or near cards make one joker.

name: Kiss-Miss-Bliss
twist: Teen tarah ke joker, do patton se
twistEn: Three joker types from two cards

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 5 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 5 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Bliss = ek jaisi jodi (8-8). Kiss = aas-paas ki rank (A-2, 9-10). Miss = ek ank chhodkar (A-3, 6-8).
setupSteps.en: Bliss = identical pair (8-8). Kiss = consecutive ranks (A-2, 9-10). Miss = one gap (A-3, 6-8).

setupSteps.hi: Har round sirf ek joker. Phir teen patte tak phenkein.
setupSteps.en: Only one joker per round. Then discard down to three.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Kissing Missing jaisa, teen tarah ke joker. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Like Kissing Missing with three joker types. Rules to be checked.

twist: Chhe patte: teen, do aur ek ka hand
twistEn: Six cards: a 3, a 2 and a 1 card hand

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 6 patte baantein. Zyada se zyada 8 log.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 6 cards to every seat. At most 8 players.

setupSteps.hi: Chhe patton ko 3-patte, 2-patte aur 1-patte ke hand mein baantein.
setupSteps.en: Arrange your six cards into a 3-card hand, a 2-card hand and a 1-card hand.

setupSteps.hi: Teeno hand baari-baari milayein. 3-patte mein plain ranking. 2-patte mein jodi bade patte se badi, phir bada patta. 1-patte mein bada patta.
setupSteps.en: Compare each hand in turn. The 3-card hand uses standard ranking. In the 2-card hand a pair beats a high card, then higher wins. In the 1-card hand the highest wins.

setupSteps.hi: Teen mein se do hand jeetne wala jeetta hai. Koi nahi jeeta to dobara khelein.
setupSteps.en: Winning at least two of the three comparisons wins the round. If nobody does, play again.

summary.hi: Do hand jeeto, round jeeto.
summary.en: Win two hands, win the round.

name: Folding Joker
twist: Pack karne wale ka chhupa patta joker
twistEn: A packed player's hidden card makes a joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 4 patte baantein: 3 khelne ke, 1 ulta alag rakhne ka.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 4 cards each: three to play and one set aside face down.

setupSteps.hi: Har koi apne teen patton mein se ek dikhaye. Uski rank sab ke liye joker.
setupSteps.en: Each player shows one of their three cards. Its rank is a joker for everyone.

setupSteps.hi: Koi pack kare to uska alag rakha patta khulta hai aur uski rank bhi joker. Pehle ke joker bane rehte hain.
setupSteps.en: When a player packs, their set-aside card is shown and its rank also becomes a joker. Earlier jokers stay.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Pack karne par naya joker. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Packing adds a joker. Rules to be checked.

name: Pairs Are Jokers
twist: Saat patte, har jodi joker
twistEn: Seven cards, every pair is a joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 7 patte baantein. Zyada se zyada 7 log.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 7 cards to every seat. At most 7 players.

setupSteps.hi: Aapke hand ki har jodi joker hai.
setupSteps.en: Every pair in your hand is a joker.

setupSteps.hi: Jodi na ho to pack karein.
setupSteps.en: With no pair, you must pack.

setupSteps.hi: Show par apne sabse achhe teen patte chunein. Sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, pick your best three cards. The best hand wins.

summary.hi: Har jodi joker. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Every pair is a joker. Rules to be checked.

note.hi: 7 aur K ki jodiyon se joker banenge.
note.en: The pairs of 7s and Ks give the jokers.

name: Joker Hunt
twist: Khule patton se joker dhoondo
twistEn: Hunt for jokers among open cards

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein. Zyada se zyada 9 log.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat. At most 9 players.

setupSteps.hi: Dealer (log x 2) + 3 patte seedhe karke rakhe.
setupSteps.en: The dealer turns (players x 2) + 3 cards face up.

setupSteps.hi: Do round tak har koi ya to ek khula patta le aur apna ek patta phenke, ya bina liye ek khula patta hata de.
setupSteps.en: Over two rounds each player either takes one open card and discards one of their own, or removes one open card without taking any.

setupSteps.hi: Do round ke baad teen khule patte bachte hain. Unki ranks joker hain. Sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: After two rounds three open cards remain. Their ranks are jokers. The best hand wins.

summary.hi: Khule patton se joker. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Jokers from open cards. Rules to be checked.

name: Rotating Jokers
twist: Pack karne wale ka khula patta joker
twistEn: A packed player's open card is the joker

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein: 1 seedha, 2 ulte.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards each: 1 face up, 2 face down.

setupSteps.hi: Seedha patta aapka apna joker hai.
setupSteps.en: Your open card is your own joker.

setupSteps.hi: Koi pack kare to uska khula patta sab ke liye joker, pehle wale ki jagah.
setupSteps.en: When a player packs, their open card becomes the joker for everyone, replacing earlier ones.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Pack par joker badalta hai. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Packing changes the joker. Rules to be checked.

name: Plus Sign
twist: Plus ke aakar mein paanch patte
twistEn: Five cards in a plus shape

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Dealer paanch patte plus (+) ke aakar mein rakhe.
setupSteps.en: The dealer lays five cards in a plus shape.

setupSteps.hi: Dealing se pehle tay karein: aadi ya khadi line ke patte joker, unki ranks.
setupSteps.en: Before dealing, decide whether the horizontal or vertical cards are the jokers (their ranks).

setupSteps.hi: Show par in jokers se hand sudharein. Sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, players use those jokers to improve their hands. The best hand wins.

summary.hi: Plus ke patte joker. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: The plus cards are jokers. Rules to be checked.

name: In-Out
twist: In ya Out bolo, teen khule joker
twistEn: Say In or Out, three open jokers

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Teen patte seedhe karke rakhein. Ye joker hain.
setupSteps.en: Three cards face up on the table are jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Har koi In (angootha upar) ya Out (angootha neeche) bole. Out walon ke patte khule jokers ki jagah aate hain.
setupSteps.en: Each player says In (thumb up) or Out (thumb down). Out players' cards replace the open jokers.

setupSteps.hi: Sabse bada In hand jeetta hai. Sirf ek In ho, to wo dealer ke nikale teen patton ke khilaf khelta hai.
setupSteps.en: The best In hand wins. If only one player is In, they play against three cards the dealer draws.

summary.hi: In ya Out. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: In or Out. Rules to be checked.

name: Zhandu
twist: Teen ulte joker, ek ek karke khulte hain
twistEn: Three hidden jokers revealed one by one

setupSteps.hi: Gaddi pheento aur har kursi ko 3 patte baantein.
setupSteps.en: Shuffle and deal 3 cards to every seat.

setupSteps.hi: Teen ulte patte joker hain. Pehle teen round ke baad ek-ek karke khulte hain.
setupSteps.en: Three face-down community jokers are revealed one after each of the first three rounds.

setupSteps.hi: Pehle round mein sab blind khelte hain.
setupSteps.en: In round 1 everyone plays blind.

setupSteps.hi: Show aur side show chauthe round ke baad hi khulte hain. Sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: Show and side show open only after round 4. The best hand wins.

summary.hi: Teen ulte joker. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Three hidden jokers. Rules to be checked.

name: Community Teen Patti
twist: Table ke patte badal sakte hain
twistEn: Swap with the table cards

setupSteps.hi: Har kursi ko 3 patte: 2 ulte, 1 seedha. Beech mein 3 aur seedhe patte.
setupSteps.en: Deal each seat 3 cards: 2 face down, 1 face up. Put 3 more face-up community cards in the centre.

setupSteps.hi: Hand banate waqt apne patte table ke patton se badal sakte hain.
setupSteps.en: You may swap your cards for table cards when forming the hand.

setupSteps.hi: Blind ya seen nahi hota.
setupSteps.en: No blind or seen play.

setupSteps.hi: Show par sabse bada hand jeetta hai.
setupSteps.en: At the show, the best hand wins.

summary.hi: Hold'em jaisa. Rules check baaki.
summary.en: Hold'em style. Rules to be checked.
